entry_context.value: In this menu you'll send your Personnel out on missions to gain lots of resources, items and unlocks!
Below is an explanation of some of the terms and keywords in this menu:

With every mission you complete, you'll gain EXP. When you reach your EXP Goal (indicated in the center area of the menu) you'll gain 1 Mastery Level. Mastery Level provides an additive bonus to lots of stuff! It's right behind this panel - in the red area of the menu.
Missions are split into 2 categories. Farm Missions (blue background) and Campaign Missions (thematically colored background).
Farm Missions can be completed multiple times whereas Campaign Missions can only be completed once.

Progressing through the Campaign will give you unique and powerful bonuses & items, as well as huge rewards of tokenium. They will also help you unlock new content & more farm missions and drive the story onwards. To infinity and beyond, right?

When you complete missions, you'll also be awarded with Mission Materials. These are used in the "Exchanges" (found by clicking an ore/stone in the inventory menu found on the "Your Academy" page). You can also use these to complete projects. They're present on all menus.
The only Mission Material that is NOT boosted by other upgrades that gives a bonus to Materials Gained, is Tokenium.

Your Zeus ship scales off it's own crew, and often also on the number of missions completed. Make sure to focus on short missions to boost this stat, and swap to longer missions once you feel like your Zeus ship is in a comfortable spot.

Some Mission Rewards (like EXP & Bonuses, etc) work right away. But to collect your AP (spent on gear) and Mission Materials (Spent in exchanges + projects) you'll need to visit the "Loot Reports" menu in the Your Academy page.

entry_context.value: The Academy menu is built up as a whole game in itself. You'll follow the "cycle" below to progress in this menu. If you're not far enough into the menu, you may not be able to see all the content discussed below, but the steps will still apply to you.
1. Print some Personnel in the "Personnel Folder" menu accessed through the bottom menu.
2. Use the RETURN button and navigate to the "Mission Control" - this is where you'll assign Personnel to complete missions. There is a whole guide on that, inside that menu!
3. Visit the blue "Loot Reports" menu indicated by the blue "messages" button found in the side menu (right behind this panel - to the side of the screen)
4. Claim the loot you've gathered during your missions.
5. Use any Academy Points (AP) in the Gear menu. This menu is accessed through the side menu (green button).

6. Use "Materials" (ores, stones and items found during missions) to purchase various goods from the "exchanges" -  these can be accessed by clicking the image of an ore in the "inventory" folder. You can also visit the "projects folder" to complete larger projects.

7. Completing projects will occasionally award you with Blueprints and Innovation Cores which are used to get powerful upgrades in the two last menus (burgundy and yellow buttons in the side menu - if you can not see these yet, you simply haven't progressed far enough). This is also how you expand your base. Whenever a base expansion is available, a green button will show up right behind this panel! Don't worry - you can't miss it.

8. Rinse and repeat! Utilizing all the upgrade menus are incredibly important to grow. It's recommended to spend a couple minutes every once in a while, reading the descriptions of various features, items and upgrades to get a good idea of how they work.
